title: hemerocallis fulva var. littorea
intro: Hemerocallis fulva var. littorea, commonly known as the Canadian daylily or orange daylily, is a perennial plant species native to North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, which include its ability to treat various conditions such as fever, sore throats, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Hemerocallis fulva var. littorea are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which help to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and ease respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
